    Potentials on hyperforests #

    Let T be a finite set of hyperedges E M ⊆ α, each with a function r M : α → ℤ. We look for w : α → ℤ such that w e + r M e is constant on each hyperedge. If two points of a hyperedge M are never joined by a walk through the other hyperedges (Berge-acyclicity), such w exists (exists_potential): add the hyperedges one at a time and shift each component of the previous ones independently.
